attack_strats: **The VIP:** One person is the VIP. Everyone else must follow them in a single-file line and protect them at all costs.
**Hot Breach:** Everyone must rappel swing into a window at the exact same time.
**Drone Phase 2.0:** You cannot enter the building until your first drone is destroyed by a defender.
**Shield Wall:** Everyone who can bring a ballistic shield, brings a shield. Phalanx formation.
**Rush Hour:** Pick your fastest operators. You must enter the building within the first 15 seconds.
**Single File:** You must walk in a single file line. Only the person in the front is allowed to shoot.
**Shotguns Only:** Primary shotguns are mandatory. If your op doesn't have one, you must use a pistol.
**No Drone November:** Absolutely no droning during the prep or action phase. Go in completely blind.
**Pacifist Planter:** The defuser carrier cannot shoot their gun. Their only job is to survive and plant.
**Red Light, Green Light:** A dead teammate calls 'Red Light' and everyone must freeze immediately. 'Green Light' means you can move.
**Demo Crew:** You must destroy every single barricade and soft wall you pass before moving forward.
**The Buddy System:** You must pair up in teams of two. You cannot move more than 5 meters away from your assigned partner.
**Nade Or Nothing:** You can only secure kills using frag grenades or explosive gadgets.
**Protect the President:** The lowest scoring player is the President. They pick an op with a pistol. Everyone else plays shields and protects them.
**Door Dash:** You can only enter the building through the main front double doors.
defense_strats: **Basement Dwellers:** Everyone anchors. Nobody is allowed to leave the objective rooms for any reason.
**The Roam Game:** Everyone deep roams. Nobody is allowed to anchor on site until the attackers start securing or planting.
**Trap House:** Pick Kapkan, Frost, Lesion, Thorn, etc. You can only get kills using traps or pistols.
**No Cams:** You are completely forbidden from looking at cameras, drones, or bulletproof cams this round.
**Hide and Seek:** Everyone hides in obscure corners across the map. You cannot shoot until they shoot you first.
**Open Concept:** Blow up every single soft wall on site during the prep phase. Absolutely zero reinforcements allowed.
**Fort Knox:** Reinforce every wall and barricade every door. You cannot leave the site once the prep phase ends.
**Nitro Cell Roulette:** No guns allowed. Kills can only be secured with C4.
**Musical Chairs:** Every 30 seconds, everyone must rotate and swap positions with another teammate.
**The Floor is Lava:** You must stand on top of a desk, counter, or piece of furniture. You cannot touch the bare floor.
**Spawn Peek Central:** Everyone must attempt a spawn peek at the start of the round.
**Silent Service:** Play Caveira, Vigil, Mute, etc. You are not allowed to sprint or make any loud noises.
**Medic Ward:** Pick Doc and Thunderbird. If anyone takes damage, they must drop everything and run back to site for a heal.
**Heavy Weights:** Pick all 3-armor operators. No fast movement allowed.
**No Defenses:** You are strictly forbidden from placing a single wooden barricade or wall reinforcement the entire round.
general_strats: **Pistols Only:** Primary weapons are strictly forbidden. Time to go full John Wick.
**Hipfire Only:** Aiming Down Sights (ADS) is illegal. Spray and pray.
**No Sprinting:** The Shift key is lava. You must walk everywhere methodically.
**Bottom Frag Leads:** The person with the lowest score dictates every single move the team makes this round.
**Backwards Headset:** Everyone must wear their headset backwards. Left is right, right is left.
**Iron Sights:** Remove all optics from your weapons. Iron sights only.
**Prone Only:** Once the action phase starts, you are only allowed to crawl.
**One Tap Wonder:** Switch all primary weapons to single-fire mode. No full auto allowed.
**Knife Fight:** No bullets allowed. Melee attacks only.
**No Reloads:** You cannot press the reload key. You must shoot until the magazine is completely empty.
**Proximity Chat:** You can only talk in Discord if your in-game operator is in the exact same room as your teammate.
**Roleplay Mode:** You must do your absolute best impersonation of the operator you are playing whenever you speak in voice chat.
**Floor Inspector:** You must stare at the floor while moving. You can only look up when actively shooting at an enemy.
**The FOV Slider:** Set your Field of View to the lowest possible setting.
